sources.observed_relation: This spec is where [Map: iMessage personas v1 (Korean testing period)](https://github.com/hena-agent/ren-ai/issues/1) was headed. Each decision below is detailed in the map's closed tickets and in ADR-0001 to ADR-0008; where this spec and a ticket differ, this spec is newer. ## Problem Statement People in Korea who would enjoy texting a fictional persona have no way to do it in the app they already use every day, iMessage, with a persona who behaves like a real person rather than a chatbot. The maintainer wants a testing period to find out whether this works: anyone with iMessage can onboard at msg.hena.dev and text Persona1, who is played from the Service handle, hi@hena.dev, by a server on the maintainer's Mac mini. The testing period has to be safe for a public audience (strangers can submit any number, and every message is untrusted input to a model), cheap enough to run on OpenCode Go's usage caps, and honest (a Notice says she's an AI and how to stop). It must run unattended on one Mac, and let the Operator watch every Conversation live and fix what breaks. The same design has to carry production's persona choice and new languages without a redesign. ## Solution A visitor ope
